newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA says 1st qtr below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA says 1st qtr below forecasts.

text.p: Electronics and gaming operator AWA Ltd said first quarter trading for its core businesses were below forecasts, but that it expected full year forecasts for its gaming and wagering unit to be met.

"Our continuing businesses performed somewhat below forecast, largely due to timing factors affecting system sales, but we are confident that the gaming and wagering and service and distribution businesses will achieve their forecasts for the full year," chairman John Iliffe told the annual meeting.
"The three businesses to be sold incurred losses during the first quarter of the current year," Iliffe said.
